## Description

Create tests/e2e journey specs (J1–J6) as skeletons: P0 implements the steps that exist (sign-in, role navigation, invite); remaining steps are marked test.fixme with the screen ID and phase so each later phase turns them green. The clinical advisor walk-through and sign-off is MDV-P1-073.

## Acceptance criteria
